integrity: The finite covariance is proved directly from a determinant-power change of measure in the Wishart density. The variance and aspect-ratio statements are derived independently from the trace Laplace transform, Bartlett decomposition, and trigamma asymptotics. A deterministic numerical checker replays the joint-transform derivatives; numerical checks are supplementary rather than proof.
scientific_limitations: The exact law is for the central real Wishart family; complex and noncentral variants require separate normalizations or arguments.
The whitened trace uses the population scale matrix and is primarily an invariant theoretical statistic when that scale is unknown.
General linear-spectral-statistic theory is a residual coverage risk for the proportional interior asymptotic correlation, though not for the exact finite matrix covariance.
title: Wishart trace–logdet alignment has an exact aspect-ratio law
